== Introduction == Duel4Tickets was a one day duel tournament organized by [[Zalon]]. What made this tournament special was that only people who were going to attend QHLAN 14 were allowed to participate and that the winner would get a free entry to the event. * Date: 2nd of October 2010 * IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ownage.qw #quakeworld] ([[QuakeNet]]) * Website: http://qhlan.quakeworld.nu/?sid=1 == Results == * 1st [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Milton]] * 2nd [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[rikoll]] * 3rd [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Paradoks]] * 4th [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Xterm]] * 5th [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Ihminen]] * 5th [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Medar]] * 7th [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[bps]] * 7th [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[en_karl]] * 9th [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[niw]] * 9th [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]] * 9th [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[trygve]] * 9th [[Image:flag_uk.gif]] [[ddk]] * 13th [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[js501]] == Admins == * [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]] == Settings, Rules, Maps == * Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[aerowalk]], [[ztndm3]] * [[Ruleset Smackdown]], no rocket jumping scripts * Time limit: 10 minutes * Overtime 3 minutes * Deathmatch mode 3 * No Powerups * Discharges enabled == Highlights == * [[Ihminen]] vs. [[Xterm]] [[dm4]] - Although Ihminen lost, he made a couple of frags easily worth the [[Frag of the week]] award. == Signups == * [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]] * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Rikoll]] * [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Milton]] * [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Ihminen]] * [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Xterm]] * [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[niw]] * [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[trygve]] * [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Medar]] * [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[ParadokS]] * [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[en_karl]] * [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[js501]] * [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[bps]] * [[Image:flag_uk.gif]] [[ddk]] == Demos == == Statistics == Signups: 13
